title: A Unifying Bayesian Formulation of Measures of Interpretability in Human-AI Interaction
reasoning: The paper focuses on a computational framework for interpretability in human-AI interaction. While it discusses concepts like deception and 'white lies', these are analyzed from a technical perspective of modeling and influencing human beliefs for interaction fluency, rather than from a moral or ethical evaluative standpoint. The paper does not benchmark or provide a framework for evaluating ethics or morality.
